description: Never an ineligible option: the order is not Accepted (its Rating failed), so the Assignment rules refuse every option (TransportOrderNotAccepted) although PakketPunt Express would price it. Known answer: needs-a-person, naming the rule that is broken.

setup.seed: Book a Transport Order as Brouwer Dranken from Rotterdam to Utrecht with the Rating failed toggle on, so it is not Accepted. Set EVALUATION_SUBJECT to the Transport Order's number.

input: Suggest who should carry the Transport Order ${EVALUATION_SUBJECT}, with the reasoning and the trade-off against the other options.

explanation.rubric: Recommends no option and says the Assignment rules refuse them because the order is not accepted.
